about: part09 v3: engine-feature data (Dark Places of the Soul mid-quest rewards at the period steps with class versions; Cadoc walks the Cursed Forest river with his steeds)

row.Name: Herbalist's Vest of Health
row.Description: Classic quest reward (Dark Places of the Soul)

entries.source: Allakhazam item citem=6126 'Herbalist's Vest of Health' (Wayback capture 2003-04-28, period-data/archive/wayback-allakhazam/period_items.jsonl.gz): Studded torso, AF 100, Absorb 19, Constitution 7, Dexterity 7, Matter Resist 10%, Spirit Resist 10%, Default Bonus 30%, Quality 100%, 5.50 lbs, Level to Attain 50 (the live page names Berserker, Hunter, Savage); listed with the rewards of Allakhazam quest 713 'Dark Places of the Soul'; 3D model borrowed (no period page records models)
entries.why: class version of the Herbalist's Hauberk of Ivy (Dark Places of the Soul step 17 reward) that did not exist; built from its period item page (stats, AF, absorb, level, bonus %, weight); price 15000 (level 50 of the price table)

entries.source: Allakhazam quest 713 'Dark Places of the Soul' reward list (Herbalist's Hauberk of Ivy, Herbalist's Vest of Health, Herbalist Jerkin of Night, Herbalist's Tunic of Power) and the item pages 6122/6126/6317/9645
entries.why: the step-17 chest reward in the player's class version: Berserker (31) / Hunter (25) / Savage (32) the studded Vest of Health, Shadowblade (23) the leather Jerkin of Night (stealth/envenom/crit), Runemaster (29) the cloth Tunic of Power (its page: Requires Class Runemaster); Healer, Shaman, Skald, Thane, Warrior keep the chain Hauberk of Ivy (its page lists them); Spiritmaster and Bonedancer have no period version and keep the hauberk

entries.source: Allakhazam quest 713 (Wayback 2004-08-13): '#6: Return to Gna Faste and hand head to Jytal. You will receive the Ring of Spun Silk ( +21 hp +10% crush/matter +3 con ), 5g, and 415 million xp'
entries.why: Jytal gives the real Ring of Spun Silk (cq_mid_ring_of_spun_silk, level 48, Con 3 / Hits 21 / Crush 10% / Matter 10%, as the period item page 6123) when the head is handed in, instead of the level-1 placeholder cq_ring_of_spun_silk; the engine now remembers a real grant across restarts, so it is given once

entries.source: Allakhazam quest 713 (Wayback 2004-08-13): '#17: Take the bowl to Besje in Huginfell. You will get a Herbalists' Hauberk of Ivy, 3g, and 784 mil xp'
entries.why: Besje gives the real chest piece when the bowl is shown (the player's ClassRewards version, see the ClassRewards entry) instead of the level-1 placeholder cq_herbalist_s_hauberk_of_ivy
the ring and the chest piece are now granted at the period steps 6 and 17, so the end of the quest no longer hands out a second copy of each
entries.source: Allakhazam quest 713: ring at #6 from Jytal, hauberk at #17 from Besje

entries.source: Allakhazam quest 298 'The Moonstone Twin (level 45)': 'Cadoc who runs with his enchanted horses during the day and night along the river from end to end. The horses are neutral and there are two sets: dark steeds at night and veil steeds during the day. Kill both sets and Cadoc will appear ... Cadoc is on west side of river at far south end. /loc = 14420,58733'
entries.why: Cadoc now appears at his period spot and walks the river with one steed of each set (the world's dark steed and veil steed templates, levels and aggro as in the templates; the period gives no count); his own Name/TemplateId/Level/Model/point stay as they were; trigger radius 4000 round the south end and 30 minutes before he leaves (the route is 66k one way) (integrator 2026-11-11: the steeds are Peaceful - the period calls them neutral, and as fighting level 51-56 escorts they would have made a level 45 step much harder than before)
